en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to familiarize the student with the use of nutrition and health claims in the food industry. For a comprehensive overview of knowledge, the course is supplemented with information on "Novel Foods", food supplements and basic labelling requirements for these foods.
